title: UnsuspendUser
description: The body of an administrative reinstatement, derived from identity_application::administration::UnsuspendUser. Structurally identical to SuspendUser: same AdminContext, same mandatory reason. They are two operations rather than one operation with a status field because each is a command with an audit consequence, and a single 'set status' endpoint would invite a console that offers status as a generic control.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; UnsuspendUserCommand has no body and no route serves it

context.description: Who is asking, and under which session. Required at AAL2.

reason.description: Why, recorded in the audit trail. Mandatory and non-empty, for the same reason as a suspension's.

x-only-suspended-can-be-reinstated.rule: a deactivated user cannot be reinstated
x-only-suspended-can-be-reinstated.source: UserStatus::permits_reactivation is true for Suspended and PendingVerification and false for Active and Deactivated
x-only-suspended-can-be-reinstated.console-rule: the console will not offer reinstatement for a deactivated account, because a control the server would refuse is a dead control with a misleading label
